verdict_summary: Dataset clears all hard ethics gates. Source is mandated public government disclosure (Florida Division of Corporations) — no auth bypass, no private data, no consumer PII. Addresses in the dataset are voluntarily filed business registration records under Florida Statutes § 119.07. Three listing conditions must be met before shipping to ensure accurate buyer expectations.

public_data_only.rationale: All 15,997 records sourced exclusively from Florida Division of Corporations (sunbiz.org) bulk filing data. This is mandated public disclosure under Florida law — no login, no auth bypass, no paywall, no scraped private database. The Florida SOS publishes this data specifically for public access. Cross-verified against brief evidence (Registered Agents Inc, Census BFS, LLC University links confirming SOS data is public).

no_pii.rationale: No SSNs, personal email addresses, phone numbers, or financial account data present. The dataset contains six field types — all are business registration disclosures, not private consumer data: (1) entity_name — trade/legal business name; (2) entity_type — entity class; (3) filing_date — public record date; (4) registered_agent_name — a person or company acting in a statutory business role, disclosed voluntarily in a public government filing; (5) registered_agent_address / principal_address — addresses filed as the official registered/principal business address under Florida Statutes; these are legally required business disclosures, not personal data extracted from private sources; (6) source_url — public government record URL. organizer_officer_name was cleared by data-steward (HTML artifact fragments, not usable), eliminating the most individual-identifying field.

registered_agent_name.reasoning: Individual names acting as registered agents (e.g., 'BALSER JAMES P', 'LAZO ACOSTA JAVIER') are disclosed in a statutory business role — the registered agent function is a legal requirement under Florida Statutes § 605.0113. Filing this name with the SOS is a voluntary public business act. It is not a personal home contact record. This mirrors standard B2B data sold by every major data provider (D&B, ZoomInfo, Experian Business) for this exact use case.

principal_address.reasoning: Some principal addresses appear residential (home-based businesses). These are the registrant's chosen principal office address filed publicly with the state as the business's official address — not data collected or inferred from personal/private sources. The registrant made a voluntary choice to use their home as their business address and to file it as a public record. This is the standard definition of a 'business address' in B2B data, even if the physical location is a residence.
principal_address.condition: Product listing must disclose that principal_address is the registered principal business address as filed with the Florida SOS, which may be a home address for home-based businesses. Buyers must be informed of this.

organizer_officer_name.assessment: NOT PRESENT — field cleared by data-steward
organizer_officer_name.reasoning: Field was emptied due to HTML artifact data quality issues. No officer name data ships in the delivered CSV. Product listing must not claim this column is populated.

source_url_on_every_row.rationale: 100% source URL coverage confirmed by steward validation report (15,997 / 15,997 rows filled). All URLs point to individual sunbiz.org entity detail pages, allowing any buyer or auditor to verify each record against the original public filing.

no_private_datasets.rationale: Data sourced entirely from Florida Division of Corporations bulk public records. No purchased data, no data broker feeds, no scraped private or login-gated sources. The opportunity brief cites registeredagentsinc.com and census.gov/econ/bfs as public proof sources; sunbiz.org used as the actual data source is of equivalent or higher standing.

no_auth_bypass.rationale: sunbiz.org is a publicly accessible state government portal. No authentication, cookies, or login required to access the bulk data. No evidence of CAPTCHA bypass or rate-limit circumvention in the data-engineer's source attribution.

steward_issues_concurrence.issue_1_entity_type_codes: CONCUR — normalization of SOS codes to human-readable labels is correct and legally accurate. No compliance concern.
steward_issues_concurrence.issue_2_century_typo: CONCUR — removal of invalid date record (MURCHIE MEDICINE INC, date 2102-07-06) is correct. No compliance concern.
steward_issues_concurrence.issue_3_out_of_window_dates: CONCUR — removal of 255 stale records enforces product freshness. No compliance concern.
steward_issues_concurrence.issue_4_organizer_officer_name: CONCUR — clearing this field was the right call both for data quality and as a precautionary compliance measure. HTML artifact fragments could have contained partial names in misleading form. Empty field ships cleanly.
steward_issues_concurrence.issue_5_address_artifact: CONCUR — correction of 'ST,PETERSBURG' to 'ST. PETERSBURG' is a data quality fix. No compliance concern.

listing_conditions.description: Product listing must NOT claim officer/organizer name data. The organizer_officer_name column is empty in the delivered CSV. Any listing copy mentioning officer names must be removed or qualified as 'not included in this release'.

Product description must accurately describe principal_address as 'registered principal business address as filed with the Florida Secretary of State — may be a home address for home-based businesses.' Do not imply it is a verified commercial office address.

Product listing must include a buyer usage notice stating: 'This data is for B2B outreach to newly registered businesses. Buyers are responsible for complying with applicable contact laws (CAN-SPAM, TCPA, Florida § 501.059) and must not use this data for consumer solicitation.' A short one-sentence disclosure on the Gumroad listing page is sufficient.

observations.description: The dataset includes 'Foreign LLC' and 'Foreign Non-Profit Corporation' entity types — businesses formed in other states but registering to do business in Florida. Buyer expectations may assume all records are Florida-native formations. Listing copy should note 'includes Florida-registered foreign entities' or filter these out for the next revision. Not a compliance blocker.

Florida Non-Profit Corporation and similar non-profit entity types are present in the dataset. Non-profits are less valuable to the target B2B buyers (insurance agents, CPAs, web designers). Consider filtering them out in future releases or offering a separate SKU. Not a compliance concern — non-profit filings are public record the same as for-profit.

registered_agent_name is populated with individual names for entities that did not use a professional registered agent service. These names appear alongside a business address. This is standard in Florida SOS data and is not a PII concern in the B2B context, but the product listing should describe this field accurately as 'Florida SOS registered agent name (person or company)' to set correct buyer expectations.

legal_basis_reference.florida_public_records_law: Florida Statutes § 119.07 — all state agency records are public unless specifically exempted. Business entity filings are not exempted.
legal_basis_reference.florida_sos_bulk_data: Florida Division of Corporations (sunbiz.org) provides bulk download access to all business entity filings as public records.
legal_basis_reference.business_registration_data_precedent: Business registration data of this type is commercially sold by Dun & Bradstreet, Experian Business, ZoomInfo, and dozens of state-licensed data resellers. The data category is legally established as B2B data, not consumer PII.
